model.name: deploy.postDeployDeviceGate
model.description: After a deploy (restart + served==committed), the trigger AUTO-runs the existing gate:device:live lane against live prod, records a version-stamped GREEN/RED/NOT-RUN result (evidence + gated Test uuids) at /api/gate-status, treats NOT-RUN as RED, never bypasses, and exposes owner-gated status to Tron.
